stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) The Arrhenius theory is the most comprehensive of all the acid-base theories. (ii) All Arrhenius acids and bases are also Bronsted-Lowry acids and bases. (iii) A Lewis base donates a proton. (iv) Water is an example of an amphoteric substance. (v) According to the Bronsted-Lowry theory, a base donates a proton.
derived: (i) False (ii) True per manifest, but convention-dependent (NaOH is an Arrhenius base, the proton acceptor is OH⁻) (iii) False (iv) True (v) False
reason: Quick-recap true/false, five parts with separate answers, no options. Part (ii) is also convention-dependent (cf. Level-6 Q8(a)).
work: Lewis is most general; Lewis base donates an electron pair; Brønsted base accepts H⁺; H₂O amphoteric.
